nodes.label: golden, vibrant, yellow, sunset
nodes.text: Golden Friday favorites 🏆 1. fluidity_pour_paints (can not at)- dragon-mode campfire 2. @wildlife_curios - golden tree, own bench 3. @angelo_marcialis_photography - blooms on black 4. @frandoll.fd - Tennessee sunrise stream 5. @1982wildcatfan - swamp mirror autumn 6. @mammakates - gradient sunset 7. jglass8 (can not at) - kiss in the sun 8. @mike___zed - walker at golden hour 9. @allemor.romella - palms, ferry, gold Questions below - answer if you like!
photos: A crackling campfire burns brightly in the dark, casting a warm glow against the night. Hints of blue flame dance among the bright orange and yellow tongues of fire, adding a magical touch to the scene.

A large tree covered in vibrant red, orange, and yellow autumn leaves stands in a park, with a wooden bench sitting under its canopy. The ground is thickly blanketed in fallen leaves, creating a warm, golden scene that captures the essence of the season.

A bright bouquet of yellow sunflowers is artfully arranged in a tall, slender white vase against a stark black background. The photo, captured by Angelo Marcialis Photography, creates a striking high-contrast composition that highlights the vibrant floral textures.

A sunlit stream flows gently through a lush green forest, reflecting the warm, golden light of the early morning. Sunlight filters through the dense canopy, creating a peaceful and serene atmosphere in the woods.

A tall tree with vibrant orange autumn foliage stands on the edge of a serene body of water, with its roots exposed above the shoreline. Its rich fall colors create a striking, rippled reflection across the calm surface of the water, evoking a peaceful seasonal mood.

A serene lake mirrors a brilliant golden sunset, casting warm, glowing hues across the water and the distant shoreline. A small flock of birds flies in the distance under a pastel sky, creating a peaceful and picturesque evening scene.

A vibrant, golden sunset casts the iconic "Unconditional Surrender" statue in San Diego in silhouette. The sun appears perfectly positioned right between the kissing sailor and nurse, creating a glowing halo effect.
A person is silhouetted against a vibrant, fiery sunset that casts a warm glow over a calm body of water from a seaside promenade framed by a large, shadowy tree.

A vibrant sunset casts a golden glow behind a row of tall, silhouetted palm trees standing along a marina. In the foreground, cars are parked near the water, with sailboats and a large vessel moored in the background, creating a quintessential coastal evening scene.

replies.text: 1/9 fluidity_pour_paints That campfire looks like it's telling stories. Backyard ritual or a somewhere-special kind of night?
2/9 @wildlife_curios A tree with its own bench feels like a destination. Is this your regular thinking spot?
3/9 @angelo_marcialis_photography Yellow blooms on a black backdrop - studio setup or a happy accident of lighting?
4/9 @frandoll.fd Sunrise on your Tennessee stream - morning routine or a one-time lucky catch?
5/9 @1982wildcatfan That mirror reflection is unreal. How still did the water have to be for this?
6/9 @mammakates Distilled to pure gradient - were you going for minimalism or did the sky just hand it to you?
7/9 jglass8 The sun landing right inside the kiss - planned timing or pure luck?
8/9 @mike___zed A lone walker, a lamppost, golden hour - did you wait for the person or were they a gift?
9/9 @allemor.romella Palms, a ferry, full blaze - is this your everyday view or a special trip?
Daily sunset, most of the times, living in Southern California.
Envy of you 🤭

nodes.label: golden, vibrant, yellow, sunset
nodes.snippet: Photographers, Golden Friday 🌟 Show me the most golden thin…
nodes.text: Photographers, Golden Friday 🌟 Show me the most golden thing in your camera roll. A sunflower, a sunset, a streetlamp glowing at dusk - if it glows gold, it counts. ONE photo. 3 favorites featured tomorrow, pin to my profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit. Yesterday’s favorites’ in.
photos: A large, ruffled, yellow-orange sunflower stands in the foreground against a clear blue sky. Other sunflowers and green foliage are visible in the slightly blurred background.

A young deer stands alert on a dirt trail, illuminated by dappled morning sunlight filtering through the trees. Its soft brown coat with faint spots and large ears stand out against the lush green grass and rocky hillside backdrop.
A massive, gold-colored sculpture of a person’s face in profile dominates the left side of the shot. In the background, the Sydney Harbour Bridge peeks through bare tree branches.

replies.text: Golden hour from my paraglider: the whole sky glows 🪂 Seeing the planet from above through a bird's eyes.
photos: A paraglider runs across a mountain launch pad during a golden-hued sunset, with the sun's reflection glittering on the water below. Several other paragliders soar in the distance above the hazy landscape.

An aerial view of a paraglider with a red canopy soaring above the turquoise waters and lush, green coastline of Ölüdeniz, Turkey. The sun sets, casting a warm golden light over the mountains and sandy beach below.
A gnarled, leafless tree stands in silhouette against a brilliant orange and yellow sunset. The vibrant sky and expansive horizon create a striking, serene evening landscape.

replies.text: My favorite dropped: https://www.threads.com/share/BAWeA5WRQw/

photos: A vibrant, deep red and orange sunflower is the main subject in this sunlit outdoor shot. A small orange butterfly rests on its dark brown center, adding a touch of natural beauty against the softly blurred background of a field and greenery.

replies.text: A butterfly holding court on a flame-colored sunflower. Golden Friday's unofficial mascot.

photos: A close-up shot captures a small, golden-brown butterfly, likely a skipper, perched on a vibrant yellow zinnia flower with a plain gray background.

replies.text: A skipper butterfly sipping from a yellow zinnia. Small wings, big golden energy.
Finishing family photos in the last of the light last night.
photos: A river flows through a landscape at dusk, reflecting the vibrant orange glow of the sunset breaking through a moody, cloudy sky. The rocky foreground and silhouetted trees along the banks create a peaceful outdoor scene.

replies.text: The last of the light doing overtime over the river rocks. Family photos with a golden encore.

photos: A single, vibrant yellow sunflower stands tall against a clear blue sky, its face tilted slightly toward the light. Lush green leaves cluster around the stem, with a field and distant trees visible in the soft-focus background, evoking a bright, sunny day in nature.

replies.text: A sunflower towering into the blue, looking down at us for once. Golden from the ground up.

photos: A lone bird glides over the ocean as the sun sets, casting a golden glow through a break in the dark clouds. Sunbeams radiate outward, reflecting brightly on the gentle waves below.

replies.text: The sun clocking out through the clouds while a pelican takes the last flight home. Golden commute.
Golden enough? 😄🌅 This one still feels like bottled evening light.
photos: A sun-kissed woman takes a high-angle selfie while on a run along a scenic lakeside trail at dusk. She wears a grey sports bra and dark shorts, with sweat glistening on her skin as she smiles.

replies.text: Golden hour doing the heavy lifting while the mountains photobomb. Golden enough? Golden plenty.
I had a feeling the mountains might steal a little attention 😄🏔️
Inside Sagrada Familia.
photos: A low-angle view captures the soaring, tree-like stone columns and intricate, rippled ceiling vaulting of the interior of the Sagrada Família. Sunlight filters through vibrant green and red stained-glass windows, casting a warm, golden glow across the architectural details.

replies.text: Gaudi doing golden hour before it was a thing. That light through the glass is unreal.
Sunset in Port Angles, WA
photos: A striking sunset glows in fiery shades of orange and gold, with horizontal clouds partially veiling the bright sun.

replies.text: Port Angeles serving pure molten gold. The ocean's just showing off the reflection.

photos: A slightly blurry, artistic photo captures bright yellow flowers blooming amidst rich green leaves. The swirling composition creates a dreamlike, impressionistic effect that feels full of natural movement.

replies.text: A swirl of yellow blooms caught mid-dance. Golden hour found them first.

photos: A wide-angle, eye-level shot captures a vibrant sunset over a calm sea, with the glowing orange horizon reflecting on the water's surface. Dark, silhouetted rocks line the foreground, while a dramatic band of clouds stretches across the bright yellow sky, creating a serene and picturesque coastal landscape.

replies.text: The horizon melting into gold, clouds doubled in the water. Signed and watermarked.
Roses in my garden. They’re called “Golden Medal”
photos: A vibrant cluster of yellow and orange roses in full bloom stands out against a backdrop of lush green foliage. The warm, sunset-hued petals capture the essence of a tranquil, sunny day in the garden.

replies.text: Roses with their own gold medal. The garden's showing off and the name checks out.

photos: A low-angle view captures a forest of tall aspen trees with bright yellow autumn leaves reaching toward a bright blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. The white trunks and golden canopy create a stunning seasonal backdrop.

replies.text: Standing under a cathedral of aspens, all gold overhead. Nature's stained glass, no filter needed.
We remarked on the stained glass feeling of it. Very magical!

photos: A vertical, eye-level shot captures a black, vintage street lamp nestled amidst a lush ginkgo tree bursting with vibrant, fan-shaped golden leaves in peak autumn foliage. Sunlight filters through the dense foliage, highlighting the rich yellow hues against a clear blue sky.

replies.text: A lamppost drowning in gold leaves, still doing its job. Autumn's streetlight.

photos: Looking up from a low angle, a large tree with vibrant yellow and green autumn leaves stretches toward a clear blue sky. Other treetops are visible at the bottom of the photo.

A vibrant, golden-yellow deciduous tree stands tall against a clear blue sky, its autumn foliage in full bloom. The tree is framed by a residential backyard with a chain-link fence and neighboring houses.

replies.text: Golden trees showing off against that blue sky. Autumn doing its best impression of sunshine.

photos: A vibrant golden sunset burns behind a silhouette of trees, contrasting with a cool, purple-tinged sky above. On the right, a street sign marks the corner of Gladiola St NW.

replies.text: Sunset on Gladiola, and the sky signed it in orange. The stop sign's just there to make you stay longer.

photos: A high-angle vertical shot shows vibrant, yellow Rudbeckia (Black-eyed Susan) flowers growing in a garden, with some withered brown leaves mixed among them. The background is a mix of green foliage and small purple flowers, with the edge of a stone patio visible at the top.

replies.text: Black-eyed Susans crowding the frame like they heard 'golden' and took it personally.

photos: An eye-level shot captures a vintage, yellow-and-silver streamlined locomotive parked inside a dimly lit train roundhouse, with a young child standing in the lower-left corner near the train's front. The massive engine features a rounded, aerodynamic nose, large wheels, and the number 490 near the front, while other railway cars and equipment are visible in the background beneath the building's steel-truss ceiling.

replies.text: Engine 490 in full golden livery. That's not a train, that's a sunset with wheels.

photos: Three red combine harvesters work their way across the steep, rolling hills of a golden wheat field under a pale blue sky. Dust billows in their wake as they reap the harvest, highlighting the hard work of the agricultural season.

replies.text: Golden wheat rolling to the horizon, combines kicking up dust. Harvest gold, straight from the field.

photos: A drooping, mature sunflower with heavy seed heads hangs over a weathered wooden fence, with a house and cloudy sky in the background.

replies.text: A sunflower bowing out gracefully, seed head heavy with the season. Golden to the very end.

photos: A young person holds a burning sparkler, creating a bright circle of light around them through long-exposure photography. The blurred background shows a brightly lit indoor space, framed by a doorway at dusk.

replies.text: A sparkler drawing a perfect golden halo. Long exposure magic, zero CGI.

photos: A vertical low angle shot captures the altar in a cathedral, featuring a large, ornate baldachin over the altar. The altar, flanked by green potted plants and lit candles, features a crucifix with Jesus.

replies.text: Gold on gold on gold - that altar's been waiting centuries for Golden Friday.

photos: A herd of alpacas gathers around a metal feeder in a fenced enclosure during a golden sunset. Tall trees and a vibrant orange sky frame the peaceful farm scene.

replies.text: An alpaca welcoming committee at golden hour. The white one's clearly the greeter.
The boys had just gotten their dinner, they were happy as could be. 😊
Golden light, quiet seas, and a fleeting moment of serenity. ✨🌅 A little piece of gold captured through my lens.
photos: A shot from the shore shows two boats on the ocean in the distance under a partly cloudy sky, with a sun beam shining down through a cloud.

replies.text: Two boats floating on liquid gold under a sky doing its best drama. Serenity, captured.

photos: A high-angle, vertical shot captures a parking lot filled with parked cars during sunset. The sky is a blend of pale blue, bright yellow, and orange, with wispy clouds floating above a line of silhouetted trees in the distance. The parking lot is empty except for the parked cars, and a few small trees are visible near the edges of the lot. The shot is framed by the dark interior of a building, with a vertical window frame on the right side and a horizontal window frame on the left. The lighting is warm and golden, casting soft shadows across the scene.

replies.text: Even the parking lot gets a golden finale through that window. The sky's doing overtime.

photos: A vibrant yellow celandine poppy stands out amidst lush green foliage, with delicate bluebells blooming softly in the background.

replies.text: Two little buttercups glowing like they swallowed the sun. Spring energy crashed autumn's thread.
It’s actually celandine poppy. But yes, spring energy for sure 💛 https://www.wildflower.org/plants/result.php?id_plant=stdi3
#TIL
仕事帰りに
photos: A low afternoon sun casts long, dramatic shadows from a row of red and white bollards lining a curved suburban street. In the background, mountains rise under a pale sky as cars drive along the road flanked by buildings and utility poles.

replies.text: The commute home, but the sun turned the whole street to gold. Rush hour never looked this good.

photos: Cascading clusters of vibrant yellow flowers bloom on a laburnum tree, set against a dark background of evergreen trees and an overcast sky.

replies.text: Golden chains of blossoms raining down. The tree's showing off and we're all just watching.

photos: A low-angle view captures a vibrant yellow flower with sunlight streaming through its translucent petals against a deep blue sky.

replies.text: Shot from below like the sunflower's a skyscraper. Those petals are basically stained glass.

photos: A vibrant mural on a gray brick wall features a bright yellow sunflower and white cotton bolls against a turquoise background, with the uplifting words "You Belong Here" written in white script above.

replies.text: A sunflower mural telling you you belong here, and the golden vibes agree.
Big Raccoon Creek. Mansfield, Indiana
photos: A red covered bridge spans a sunlit river, surrounded by trees displaying autumn colors. The foreground features a grassy bank under overhanging branches, with bright sunlight reflecting off the water.

replies.text: A red covered bridge crashing the golden foliage party. Big Raccoon Creek understood the assignment.

photos: A high-angle shot shows a vibrant bouquet of yellow and cream-colored roses, mixed with a large yellow gerbera daisy, delicate white filler flowers, and green leaves, all wrapped in clear cellophane and resting on a dark surface.

replies.text: A bouquet that smells like sunshine through the screen. The gerbera's the loud one in the group.
Variations on yellow
photos: An eye-level, medium long shot depicts a golden hour view from the shoreline, with a glowing sun peeking through a dark cloud formation. The dark silhouette of a small island sits on the horizon in the left-center, while the silhouettes of several palm trees are visible in the lower right.
A golden retriever puppy peacefully sleeps on a wooden staircase as a patch of sunlight warms its fur.

replies.text: A golden sunset and a golden dog napping through it. The variations are strong with this one.

photos: A close-up, top-down shot of a vibrant yellow marigold flower in full bloom, set against a soft, out-of-focus green background.
A fluffy orange cat is lying down comfortably, with its eyes closed in deep relaxation. The feline appears to be dozing off on a soft surface, making for a cozy and heartwarming scene.
A close-up shot captures two vibrant yellow gerbera daisies in full bloom, surrounded by lush green foliage. Perfect for brightening up a spring garden post.

A small bee rests on the vibrant yellow petals of a blossom, surrounded by lush green foliage and unopened buds. This close-up shot captures a peaceful moment in nature, perfect for a garden or wildlife appreciation post.

replies.text: Marigold, gerbera, and a ginger cat asleep mid-photoshoot. The cat's the most golden thing here and it knows it.

photos: A vibrant, multi-petaled yellow hibiscus flower glistens with water droplets after a refreshing rain. The intricate details of its ruffled petals and central stamen are captured against a soft, dark background.

replies.text: A hibiscus wearing raindrops like jewelry. Golden and dripping, literally.
Really appreciate your kind words, thank you..
Anytime - that hibiscus earned every word.

photos: A low-angle view captures a massive, rugged tree trunk extending toward a bright blue sky, its branches covered in vibrant yellow autumn leaves. Sunlight filters through the canopy, highlighting the changing foliage and the deep ridges of the bark.

replies.text: Lying on the forest floor, staring up at a tree doing its golden fireworks impression. Best seat in the woods.

photos: A dense forest showcases vibrant autumn foliage, featuring a striking contrast of fiery red and golden yellow leaves against a backdrop of bare tree trunks.

replies.text: Red maples arguing with golden everything. Autumn's having a full color debate and everyone's winning.

photos: Vivid pink and purple sunset clouds fill the sky above a calm lake that perfectly mirrors the colors and the tree line on the far bank.

A lone person walks along a winding dirt path under a dramatic, fiery sunset sky filled with vibrant pink, purple, and orange clouds. In the background, the silhouettes of trees, low hills, and suburban houses frame the serene evening landscape.

replies.text: The lake doing its best pink-sky impression, and nailing it. That reflection is showing off.

photos: A close-up, low-angle shot captures a vibrant red and yellow mushroom, likely an *Amanita*, standing proudly in a forest undergrowth. The dappled sunlight filtering through the trees creates a soft, glowing background, perfect for a nature-themed post.

replies.text: That mushroom dressed up as autumn itself. The yellow stem is doing all the talking.

photos: A bumblebee rests on the vibrant, pollen-dusted center of a bright yellow sunflower in full bloom. The flower is set against a sun-dappled field of sunflowers under a clear sky, capturing the essence of a warm summer day.
A vast field of bright yellow sunflowers stretches under a dramatic cloudy sky, with the afternoon sun peeking through the clouds above a distant treeline.

A vast field of bright yellow sunflowers stretches towards a dark tree line, their faces turned upward in the sunlight. This radiant sea of blooms makes a vibrant, cheerful nature scene that's ready to brighten up any feed.

A vibrant field of bright yellow sunflowers stretches towards a lush treeline under a partially cloudy blue sky. Sunlight filters through the trees, casting a warm glow across the landscape on a gorgeous summer day.

replies.text: A bee clocked in for the golden shift. That sunflower's basically running a tiny honey factory.
Does a Golden Retriever count? 🤔
photos: A happy golden retriever wearing a yellow "Landshark" life jacket with a blue fin rests on the white vinyl seat of a pontoon boat. In the background, a lake ripples under a partly cloudy sky, with green, tree-covered hills lining the distant shore.

replies.text: It counts. It counts so hard the vest says LANDSHARK and the lake agrees.

photos: A fiery desert sunset paints the sky in brilliant orange and gold tones, silhouetting a majestic saguaro cactus and distant mountain ranges. The lush desert vegetation in the foreground adds depth to this peaceful, scenic landscape.

replies.text: A saguaro standing guard while the whole desert turns gold. That cactus has seen a thousand of these and never brags.

photos: Framed by a glowing, warm-lit circular window near the roof of a house, a person holds a small dog in silhouette against the golden light. Lush green foliage rises from the bottom foreground, partially obscuring the light gray, vertically-paneled exterior wall of the building.

replies.text: A cat framed in a porthole, glowing like a tiny ship's captain. Golden hour delivered by the captain himself.

photos: A high-angle, eye-level shot captures a gathering over drinks, featuring four glasses with various beers arranged on a grey table. In the foreground, a dark-colored beer with a thin, foamy head is centered. Behind it, a pale yellow beer in a glass curves inward, while another pale yellow beer with a thick, foamy head is on the left. On the right, a tall glass is filled with a bright orange beverage. In the background, people out of focus are seated at the table.

A serene lake mirrors a vibrant sunset filtering through silhouetted trees, casting a golden glow across the water. A distant dock and a few boat slips frame the tranquil horizon, making it an ideal scenic view for nature lovers.

replies.text: Four golden pours lined up, then a sunset melting into the lake like it had nowhere else to be. Golden hour, fully committed - cheers to that.

photos: A low-angle shot showcases a large mushroom with a mottled cap and thick stem, growing out of dark wood mulch next to a brick wall. A smaller mushroom of the same variety hides beneath the cap of the larger one.

replies.text: Mushrooms flashing their gills like they invented the pose. The mulch runway, obviously.

photos: A bright golden sunset reflects off a modern multi-story apartment building, contrasting with a cloudy blue sky. Below, a lower brick building with a pointed roof sits in the foreground, with a distant city skyline visible on the horizon.

A vibrant pink and orange sunset paints the sky over a city street lined with modern apartment buildings and storefronts. Below, the quiet road and parking lot lead the eye toward the colorful skyline in the distance.

A brown butterfly with distinct orange and white markings rests peacefully on the bright yellow petals of a blooming sunflower. The sunlit flower stands tall against a blurred background of what appears to be a balcony or outdoor setting.

A photo of an ocean sunset, captured with a fiery orange horizon and moody gray and white clouds, is overlaid with the quote, "Sunsets are proof that not all endings are bad, but some are actually BEAUTIFUL," written in all-caps, white font. A small red heart icon is visible on the lower right-hand side of the image.

A wide landscape view features rolling green hills under a bright, cloudy sky with a soft yellow and orange glow near the horizon, suggestive of sunrise or sunset. The foreground is a neatly manicured lawn with a long, low green hedge running horizontally across the middle ground, dotted with a few trees.

replies.text: Swamp Sunflower super bloom, Lake Jesup, Florida.
photos: A vast field of vibrant yellow wildflowers stretches out beneath a cloudy sky, with two palm trees standing tall in the middle distance near a body of water.

replies.text: Dale Chihuly, Seattle
photos: A vibrant yellow, red, and blue Chihuly glass sculpture is displayed in front of a modern greenhouse at the Atlanta Botanical Garden, perfectly framed against a cloudy sky.

A vibrant canopy of autumn leaves in shades of gold and amber filters the bright sunlight above a tranquil lake. The winding path, covered in fallen leaves, invites viewers to step into this picturesque fall landscape.

replies.text: Autumn going full gold beside the lake. That light through the trees.
It’s my fave time of year 🤩

photos: Bright yellow bougainvillea flowers with delicate, papery bracts and vibrant green leaves are captured in a close-up, natural shot, suggesting a sunny day in a garden.

replies.text: Backlit blooms glowing like little lanterns. Golden hour, bottled.
Terimakasih

photos: A macro photograph captures a vibrant bouquet of flowers, featuring a deep purple zinnia, a yellow-and-pink African daisy, a fluffy golden sunflower, and delicate white chamomile blossoms. The tight framing highlights the rich textures and striking colors of each bloom, making it a cheerful option for a nature or gardening social media post.
A close-up, high-angle shot captures a vibrant teddy bear sunflower in full bloom, showcasing its dense, textured layers of golden-yellow petals and intricate dark center.

replies.text: A whole bouquet with a teddy-bear sunflower stealing the show. Golden and fluffy.
Golden horizon
photos: A wooden dock extends into a tranquil lake as a flock of seagulls takes flight against a vibrant sunset sky. The golden light reflects off the water, creating a serene and picturesque landscape.

replies.text: Golden horizon indeed - the birds even showed up for the show.

photos: An eye-level shot captures a polished, gold-colored, asymmetrical, egg-shaped dish on a white surface inside a display case with a bright white background. The dish reflects light on its smooth surfaces and casts a soft, blurry shadow downward.

replies.text: A bowl so golden it looks like it pours light. Museum-grade Golden Friday.

photos: Giant metallic Christmas ornaments, in shades of gold and red, decorate a modern building exterior during the holiday season. The oversized baubles create striking reflections of the surrounding architecture and passersby on the ground level.

replies.text: Ornaments the size of beach balls. Go gold or go home.

photos: A vertical shot shows a golden Emmy statue against an outdoor backdrop of a partly cloudy sky, green trees, and water.
A tall, slender plant grows from among rocks in the foreground, framing the setting sun in the background. Two houses and a large tree stand in the distance under a blue and gold sky.

replies.text: The sun setting behind the house while the seed heads stand at attention. Golden hour, guarded.

photos: A fluffy tricolor Shetland Sheepdog stands on a gravel path covered in fallen leaves, illuminated by golden hour sunlight. The dog is on a leash, ready for a sunset walk in the park.

replies.text: A fluffy supervisor inspecting the autumn leaves. Golden Friday's quality control.

photos: A vibrant low-angle shot captures a forest of aspen trees with brilliant yellow autumn leaves glowing under the sunlight. The bright sun peeks through the canopy, creating a natural lens flare that adds a warm, magical touch to the scene.

replies.text: The sun blazing straight through the golden canopy. Nature's spotlight.
Au Dead Center
photos: An artistic collage displays nine chemical elements from the periodic table, rendered with distressed textures against a vibrant, multi-colored background. The tiles, including Ti, Pb, Kr, Pt, Au, Pu, P, Fe, and Mn, form the name "T-I-G-E-R-P-A-W-S," making this a creative visual for a school or science-themed social media post.

replies.text: Au, dead center. The periodic table's most on-theme element.
Sunrise on my stream in Tennessee
photos: A tranquil stream reflects the golden light of the sun filtering through a lush, dense forest canopy. The peaceful scene is bathed in a warm, serene glow, making it an idyllic escape into nature.

replies.text: Sunrise pouring gold down your Tennessee stream. Worth waking up for.

photos: A vibrant orange and pink sunset fills the sky over the Fraser River, with the Port Mann Bridge silhouetted against the colorful horizon.

replies.text: Yellow rose with a passenger😎
photos: A close-up shot captures a vibrant yellow rose in full bloom, surrounded by dark green leaves. A small bee feeds near the center of the blossom, highlighted by warm daylight.

replies.text: A golden rose with a bee passenger riding first class.

photos: A cluster of vibrant yellow roses blooms in front of a rustic, weathered wagon wheel leaning against a stone wall. The flowers contrast with the iron spokes and earth tones, adding a charming, rustic touch to a sunlit garden.
A patio set and a shed are buried under a thick blanket of bright yellow autumn leaves.

replies.text: Yellow roses against a wagon wheel, then a patio buried in gold leaves. Two golden moods.

photos: A vibrant golden hour view frames two silhouetted palm trees against a sunlit ocean, with a distant sailboat floating on the horizon. The glowing sky, tranquil waves, and sandy beach create a serene tropical atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing vacation post.

replies.text: Sunset framed by palms like nature's own postcard border. Classic gold.
Golden hour from my paraglider: the whole sky glows 🪂 Seeing the planet from above through a bird's eyes.
photos: A paraglider runs across a high, sunlit platform just before taking flight over the sea at sunset. Other gliders are already airborne in the golden, hazy sky, while a mountainous coastline drops away sharply to the right.

A paraglider with a vibrant red canopy soars high above a stunning coastal landscape, featuring lush green mountains, a picturesque lagoon, and a sandy beach meeting the clear blue sea. The warm, golden hour sunlight casts a magical glow over the entire scene, perfect for an adventurous travel post.

replies.text: Golden hour from a paraglider - the whole sky glowing. Best seat in the house.

photos: A large, vibrant yellow sunflower is the centerpiece of a sunny garden, partially framed by lush green foliage and delicate wispy stems. Three fuzzy bumblebees are busily pollinating the center of the sunflower, captured in bright natural light.

replies.text: A sunflower nodding under the weight of its own seeds, bees all over it. Golden and busy.

photos: Golden aspen trees in peak autumn foliage frame a distant view of mountains and valleys, with sunlight filtering through the vibrant yellow canopy.

replies.text: Aspens turned to gold with a lake behind them. That's a postcard that took itself.

photos: A vibrant yellow sunflower stands tall against a backdrop of a blue sky and distant trees, with a tiny green bee perched on its dark center.

replies.text: A sunflower and its bee, both clocked in for Golden Friday.
Wow!!

photos: A weathered brown wooden building, possibly a historic mine or cabin, sits nestled in a hillside covered in vibrant yellow and green autumn foliage under a clear blue sky.

A vibrant slope of autumn foliage displays brilliant yellow aspen trees contrasting with dark green evergreens under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, rocky scree slopes are framed by dark evergreen trees, suggesting a scenic hike in the mountains.

A vast pile of gray rocks dominates the foreground, framed by dark evergreen branches on either side. In the background, a hillside is covered in a dense forest of vibrant yellow and green trees, with the bright yellow foliage of deciduous trees creating a stark contrast against the darker pines.
Two hot air balloons, one featuring the Zia sun symbol from the New Mexico state flag, float in a bright blue sky above a desert landscape with mountains in the background.

replies.text: A hot-air balloon floating over golden fields. Friday, upgraded to sky mode.

photos: A park bench rests beneath a large tree bursting with vibrant autumn foliage in shades of orange, yellow, and red. The ground is thickly blanketed with fallen leaves, creating a warm, golden scene illuminated by soft sunlight.

replies.text: A golden tree with its own bench underneath. Prime seating for golden hour.

photos: A serene sunset casts a warm yellow and orange glow across a calm lake, with a distant tree line and a few birds in flight on the horizon.

replies.text: The water holding the sunset like it's afraid to let go. Beautiful.

photos: A winding paved path cuts through a dense forest, with the ground and trees blanketed in vibrant yellow and green autumn leaves.

replies.text: A golden path through the autumn woods. Walk it like you own it.

photos: A vertical, close-up shot captures a dried golden thistle plant, centered in the frame. The flower head of the plant is comprised of golden-brown petals that appear dry, with sharp spikes protruding outward in every direction. The stem below the flower has sharp points, and the background shows green grass and brown dirt.

nodes.text: Shadow Thursday favorites 🏆 Four shadows that stopped me mid-scroll. Full credit to the photographers - tagged below. 1. @petestretchphotos - B&W, one long shadow racing across wet sand toward the water 2. @nofussgus_ - a mid-leap dog with its long shadow chasing behind 3. @bojonvelvet2.0 - a red chair wearing window-blind stripes 4. @ahm0711 - sunset leaking through a dune fence, striping the sand Each of you gets a question in the thread below - answer if you like. We'd love the story.
photos: A black-and-white, vertical, eye-level, wide shot depicts four children on a wide, sandy beach at the edge of the ocean under a cloudy sky. The children are silhouetted against the bright sunlight reflected off the ocean water, making the ocean a pale grey and the sky a mottled light grey and white. Three children stand near the water's edge, close to the center, while a fourth child, wearing a dress with ruffles, runs toward them from the foreground. Her elongated shadow trails behind her to the bottom edge of the frame. The other three children have smaller shadows cast almost directly beneath them.

A small, fluffy dog is captured mid-air in a joyful leap along the shoreline of a sandy beach, with gentle waves rolling in the background. The low afternoon sun casts a long, distinct shadow of the pup onto the damp sand, complete with paw prints leading up to the action.
Sunlight streams through closed blinds, casting a dramatic pattern of bright stripes and deep shadows across a vibrant red wooden chair and the hardwood floor.

A wooden sand fence runs diagonally across the frame, casting long shadows onto the beach below as the sun sets over the ocean. The vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of orange and pink, creating a peaceful and serene coastal scene.
A person wades along the wet sand at the water's edge, silhouetted against a bright, sunlit ocean where a strong sunburst breaks through the sky overhead.

replies.text: 2nd👍
Cool 😎
Yeah, credit to the photographers 🙏
@ahm0711 Sunset through the dune fence - did you plan the timing, or stumble straight into golden hour?
Completely by accident. Sunsets in Michigan, regardless of the season, are always incredible!

@bojonvelvet2.0 That red chair in the window-blind stripes - staged moment, or a lucky glance across the room?
Nah, I never stage photos. It was at a friend’s house and just happened to be visiting at the right time of day.
I love the color and the lights. Good shot. Thank you so much for sharing. 🙏
@nofussgus_ Caught mid-leap with the shadow chasing behind. Burst mode, or pure luck and fast fingers?
Absolute pure luck

Gus is my assistance dog and I started taking photos of him to remind myself of what I’d done during the day. I have memory issues. Now, with his help I experience life with a bit more continuity but I still love taking photos of our adventures and ordinary life together.
